title: Supported extension on the actual coefficient systems
statement: Fix a prime l and an algebraic closure Ω of Q_l. Index coefficients by the finite intermediate fields E of Ω/Q_l, as in [def-weil-finite-subextension-directed-set]. Let U,V be noetherian schemes of finite topological Krull dimension with l invertible on both. Use the actual raw and Karoubi scalar systems of [def-sbc-ambient-complete-coefficient-categories]. Given a morphism F between their raw systems with identity reflexive β, there exists a morphism K between their actual Karoubi systems satisfying KarMorphismSpec from [lem-sbc-stage-system-karoubi-extension]: Φ_K(E)=functorExtension₂.obj Φ_F(E), β_K(a) is heterogeneously equal to functorExtension₂.mapIso β_F(a), and β_K(id) is identity. Given two such F,G and a compatible raw Hom α, the two supported morphisms can be constructed together with a compatible Hom η whose τ(E) is heterogeneously equal to functorExtension₂.map α.τ(E). The generic supported system is equal to the actual Karoubi system.

proof.text: The actual Karoubi transitions are precisely functorExtension₂ on the raw transitions. Its associator differs from the generic extended associator only by the inverse coefficientCompositionIso, which is the identity. The abstract identity-composition lemma and system extensionality therefore identify the two systems. Specialize the generic supported morphism and compatible-transformation existence theorems along these equalities. Their construction transports the concrete karMorphism and karHom; the raw scalar identity laws provide the transition units, so their component, comparison and unit APIs apply verbatim.
